about: Hand labels for the demo library (scripts/demo_library.py), for python -m app.tagging --eval --labels and scripts/evals.py (#6, #57): the one category each reel belongs in, read against the category notes in app/tagging/llm.py, or null where none fits. Judgement calls: DQcaminand1, a short film made in Blender, is Design (art), not Technology (computing); DQcoffeesr1, an industrial bean sorter, fits none; DQblackhol1, astronomy, and DQsealion01 are Nature & science since #145; the two cat reels stay none, as pets; DQcalamari1 and DQkaohsiun1 are about the food more than the place; DQkyotost01 is a place to go more than a photograph.
